intent: Record which agent drafted each proposed element.

edit.summary:
I added a `drafted_by` field to the `Element` object and made `propose_element` fill it in. Both changes are in the `authoring` domain, and `check_draft` reports no issues. I didn't change `delivery`.

- **`objects.Element`:** `drafted_by` is a new optional string property. Everything else on the element is as it was.
- **`actions.propose_element`:** a new effect sets `target.drafted_by` from `actor.id`. I also reworded the description to say it records who drafted the element.

One thing to check before this ships: `actor.id` may name the person the agent acts for, not the agent itself. If so, it won't tell the owner which agent drafted badly. I couldn't tell from the declaration whether the tool exposes a separate agent identity, so I used `actor.id`, the same expression `approve_commit` uses for the approver. If you want the agent named, `propose_element` would need an agent identifier, either a new field the agent fills in or whatever the tool provides.
edit.diff:
--- a/authoring.domain.yaml
+++ b/authoring.domain.yaml
@@ -102,10 +102,13 @@
       second_confirmed:
         type: boolean
         optional: true
-    source:
-      kind: interview
-      ref: interview:domains/authoring/interview.jsonl#L42
-    status: confirmed
+      drafted_by:
+        type: string
+        optional: true
+    source:
+      kind: interview
+      ref: interview:domains/authoring/interview.jsonl#L58
+    status: proposed
   DecisionRequest:
     description: A decision only a person may take, proposed with grounds and a recommendation
       and sent to that person's outbox.
@@ -345,7 +348,8 @@
       ref: records:docs/adr/0037-switch-over-to-the-generated-self-domains.md#L8-L25
     status: confirmed
   propose_element:
-    description: Propose a draft element that cites where it came from.
+    description: Propose a draft element that cites where it came from, and record
+      which agent drafted it.
     actor:
     - owner
     creates: Element
@@ -364,6 +368,8 @@
     effects:
     - set:
         target.permission: params.permission
+    - set:
+        target.drafted_by: actor.id
     - call: propose_element
       with:
         path: target.path
@@ -372,8 +378,8 @@
       reply: record_proposal
     source:
       kind: interview
-      ref: interview:domains/authoring/interview.jsonl#L38
-    status: confirmed
+      ref: interview:domains/authoring/interview.jsonl#L58
+    status: proposed
   confirm_element:
     description: Confirm a drafted element. Only a person confirms; an element about
       who may approve or deploy also needs a second person's confirmation.
